issues.title: Loan Simple leads receiving duplicate tasks in post-referral and other workflows
issues.desc: HAs and TCs were receiving duplicate tasks for Loan Simple leads across multiple workflows including pre-referral and post-referral. The root cause was a bugged filter related to Loan Simple lead associations in HubSpot, which caused leads to qualify for multiple workflow branches simultaneously. HubSpot support was engaged and confirmed the issue resolved.
issues.workaround: Review any LS leads that received duplicate tasks during the impact window and manually close or delete the duplicate tasks as needed.

issues.title: Offer Accepted workflow not re-enrolling deals that previously fell through
issues.desc: When a deal was marked Offer Accepted, fell through, and was later marked Offer Accepted again, the TC assignment workflow did not trigger tasks the second time because re-enrollment was not enabled. This affected TCs who did not receive tasks or closing info collection prompts for repeat-contract deals. The workflow was updated to allow re-enrollment.
issues.workaround: For any deals that went Offer Accepted a second time during the impact window without triggering TC tasks, manually enroll the deal into the TC assignment workflow.

issues.title: MRC and TC Sale Pending and Offer Accepted workflows not triggering correctly
issues.desc: MRC deals updated to Offer Accepted and Sale Pending were not enrolling into TC workflows, resulting in TCs not receiving tasks. The issue affected MRC and other lender deals from approximately February 26 through April 1. HubSpot support was engaged and a fix was confirmed.
issues.workaround: For any MRC or TC deals that moved to Offer Accepted or Sale Pending between February 26 and April 1 without triggering tasks, manually enroll the deal into the relevant TC workflow.

issues.title: Post-referral workflow tasks not stopping when deal marked Closed Lost or Transferred
issues.desc: HAs continued to receive post-referral workflow check-in tasks even after deals were marked as Closed Lost or Transferred. The workflow lacked proper suppression filters for these terminal deal stages. A filter tweak was applied on March 9 to address the issue.
issues.workaround: Manually delete any check-in tasks that were incorrectly generated for Closed Lost or Transferred deals during the impact window.

issues.title: Post-referral workflow not triggering for lead with data-pull error
issues.desc: A referral accepted on March 18 did not generate any post-referral workflow tasks for the HA. The root cause was an error in how data was being pulled, which prevented the workflow from filtering correctly. The issue was escalated to the product team for resolution.
issues.workaround: For leads accepted around March 18 that did not receive post-referral tasks, manually enroll the deal into the post-referral workflow.

issues.title: Buyer credit SMS sent at Offer Accepted stage without credit amount populated
issues.desc: An SMS notifying buyers of their credit amount was incorrectly triggered at the Offer Accepted stage before closing information had been submitted, meaning the credit amount was blank. The SMS should only fire at the Sale Pending stage once the credit amount is calculable. The issue was identified as a Dash-triggered communication and escalated to the product team.
issues.workaround: For buyers who received the incomplete credit SMS at Offer Accepted, manually send a corrected credit amount communication once closing information is submitted.
